text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day! Normally, it's 
just a day spent doing trainer work or 
enjoying a day off, but—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The meeting spot is over here, 
over here!!

text_block_list.name: Shift Leader
text_block_list.text:
Now then, all part-time workers will 
undergo training. First, please look at 
the materials in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This week, with Ines Fujin's help, I took 
on the same one-off gig jobs alongside her 
whenever I had free time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was all to squeeze out more practice 
time for the next race. I thought if the 
two of us worked a part-time job together, 
it would cut the time in half, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeee!? Trainer is being attacked by 
birds!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems handling a new part-time job 
as efficiently as she does is quite 
difficult."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Are you really okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's great that you took responsibility 
and showed up! Though sometimes, saying "I 
can't do it!" and retreating is a 
courageous move too, don't you think~?
choice_data_list: Today's the day I give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah. First, turn your head this 
way. You still have bedhead."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, at a massive event venue, I ended 
up working diligently at a part-time job 
doing nothing but wrapping chocolates—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So, going by the explanation, wrapping 
it like this should be okay, right?
choice_data_list: Ines, you're really good at gift wrapping!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Don't underestimate the ultimate 
part-timer! Something like this is a total 
piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, regarding your gift-wrapping 
skills...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! You wrap things so neatly! Is 
there a trick to it?!

text_block_list.name: Shift Leader
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally! You've got great form! 
Could you help out that group over there 
too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, Trainer's getting praised~ Kinda 
takes the wind out of my sails~.
choice_data_list: I can finally be of help!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...That's right, yes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if that's the case, sounds like 
there's nothing at aall I can teach you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? But I'm not gonna lose when it comes 
to speed either!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's power through this work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, stuck in a corner of the venue, I 
did nothing but wrap packages endlessly—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Good work, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Shift Leader
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone~! I've got souvenirs 
for you, so please take one each~.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Workers
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Go ahead and take two, 
including mine.
choice_data_list: Huh, but what about Agnes Fujin's share...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Come on, hurry up and get in 
line to receive chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Because this is pretty much the only 
thing I can do for them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, nudged on by a strangely pouting 
Ines Fujin, I ended up receiving two 
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, stuck in a corner of the venue, I 
did nothing but wrap packages endlessly—

text_block_list.name: Event Department Head
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Thanks for coming to help out, 
kiddo! Here, take this assortment of our 
chocolates as a bonus!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you ended up being leaned on 
the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you even went out of your way to 
help the other part-timers. You didn't 
show a single bumbling side of yourself at 
all.
choice_data_list:
Let's eat the chocolate we got as a reward 
together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Hehe, ahaha! Yeah, you're right. 
Ahhh-...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I guess I was just sulking. Over such a 
silly reason, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'll buy you a drink to go with 
that chocolate. Let me treat you for once, 
nano.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your hard work today. Let's 
celebrate doing a good job. ...Though I 
can only spend about a hundred yen on it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, with canned coffee from the 
convenience store in one hand, Ines Fujin 
and I stuffed our faces with chocolate 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All the while, her eyes narrowed into a 
joyful smile.
